delta:

The SECOND image is the `lettering-marker-italic` environment reference — preserve its authored place facts. The THIRD image is the channel's SCENE STYLE TILE — a register sample ONLY. It pins LINE WEIGHT, the outline colour (#241a12), the FLAT-CEL RENDER, and PALETTE SATURATION — match how strongly its flat fills are coloured and lay THIS frame's own hues, warm or cool, down at that same strength; a frame drained to neutral grey has failed to take the register. Take NOTHING else from it — not its content, not its objects, not its layout or camera, and NOT the place it depicts. This image is not a location and never appears in the frame you draw.

The same shop interior held exactly: three shelf bays of beige boxed home computers on the back wall, oak counter foreground-right with the brass till, cream-and-teal linoleum, the street door open stage-left, the window card carrying '1983' — that window card is the ONE AND ONLY place the text '1983' appears anywhere in this frame; there is NO second card, no tent card, no placard, no sign and no label bearing '1983' or any other text standing on the oak counter or anywhere else in the room. Only this changes: an opened wooden crate now stands at the counter's near end with packing straw spilling over its lip and one beige machine half unwrapped inside it; everything else exactly as established.
